title: Uvavanyo lweLanga eliNgcwele
intro: Kwilizwe lamandulo apho ukuzinikela kwilitye eliqingqiweyo kwakusele kuqalile kuyo yonke imizi, umntu omnye wayema ​​ngokwahlukileyo. Ngenxa yokuqiniseka okungagungqiyo kunye nokukhuselwa nguThixo, bajongana nokufa okwakufanele ukuba kuqinisekile - baza bahamba bengonzakalanga. Ungayifumana na intsingiselo yalo mphefumlo umangalisayo?
clues: Ndakhulela phakathi kwabantu ababenqula izithixo ababeziqophile ngezandla zabo, bekholelwa ukuba ezi zinto zinamandla kaThixo.
Xa ndandiphikisa iinkolelo zabo, ekuqaleni bandigxotha, kodwa andikwazanga ukuthula ngenyaniso endandiyazi.
Ngosuku ababehlanganisene ngalo, ndazitshabalalisa izithixo zabo, ndashiya kuphela esona sikhulu singachukunyiswanga.
Bathi bakubuya baza babona into endiyenzileyo, iinkokeli zabo zayalela ukuba kwakhiwe umngxuma omkhulu, zifuna ukundiphosa emlilweni.
Bandiphosa emlilweni ovuthayo, kodwa iNkosi yehlabathi yayalela ukuba uphole kwaye ukhuseleke kum.
Ndaphuma elangatyeni ndingenzakalanga kwaphela, ngoxa abo babeceba ukundibulala babejongene nomonakalo omkhulu.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: UAllah wenza umlilo waphola kwaye wakhuseleka
Isithixo segolide sanyibilika phambi kwamehlo abo
Ingqwayingqwayi kunye nomkhosi wayo batshona elwandle
outcome.answer: UAllah wenza umlilo waphola kwaye wakhuseleka

arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verse: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act." (21:68)
